title: Beyond 4 bits: Data-Centric Post-training Quantization and Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.28537v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses the weights of a trained model with limited compute and data. Down to 4 bits it is near-lossless, but at 2 bits scalar PTQ configurations fall to chance-level accuracy. We study three choices usually treated as implementation details that matter little at 4 bits but decide 2-bit quality: the quantization representation, the calibration data, and the recovery fine-tuning data, across six dense and mixture-of experts models (ranging from $3.8$ to $32$B parameters). Representation is the largest factor and vector codebooks restore usable models where scalar PTQ pipelines collapse. Most of the remaining loss in accuracy is on \emph{generative} tasks, and the amount of performance drop is model-dependent. translated_title: 超越4比特：以数据为中心的训练后量化与恢复
translated_abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）能在有限的计算资源和数据条件下压缩已训练模型的权重。在4比特精度下它几乎无损，但在2比特时，标量PTQ配置的准确率会降至随机猜测水平。我们研究了三个通常被当作无关紧要的实现细节的选择——量化表示、校准数据和恢复微调数据——它们在4比特时影响甚微，却决定了2比特量化的质量。实验覆盖了六个稠密模型和混合专家模型（参数量从3.8B到32B）。其中，量化表示是最大的影响因素，向量码本能够在标量PTQ流程完全失效的情况下恢复出可用的模型。剩余的准确率损失大部分出现在生成式任务上，且性能下降幅度因模型而异。此外，在较短的恢复训练预算下，校准数据与恢复数据是相互耦合的：最佳的恢复数据取决于所用的校准数据，因此二者必须联合选择。由此得出的配方（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文发现量化表示、校准数据和恢复微调数据这三个在4比特量化时影响甚微的选择在2比特量化时起决定性作用，其中向量码本表示是恢复模型可用性的最大因素，且校准数据与恢复数据必须联合选择。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that three choices—quantization representation, calibration data, and recovery fine-tuning data—that barely matter at 4-bit quantization become decisive at 2-bit, with vector codebooks being the largest factor for restoring usable models and calibration and recovery data needing to be chosen jointly.
